item.text: {"action":"batch","arguments_json":"{\"calls\":[{\"action\":\"run\",\"arguments\":{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import copy,json,math; from work import evaluate; p={'base_unit':'m','units':{'m':1,'cm':0.01},'unique':True}; cases=[({'rows':[{'id':'a','amount':2,'unit':'cm'},{'id':'b','amount':3}]},{'ok':True,'records':[{'id':'a','amount':0.02,'unit':'m'},{'id':'b','amount':3,'unit':'m'}],'errors':[]}),({'rows':[{'id':'','amount':-1,'unit':'x'},{'id':'a','amount':True},{'id':'b','amount':float('inf')},{'id':'c','amount':1,'unit':'x'},{'id':'d','amount':1},{'id':'d','amount':2}]},{'ok':False,'records':[],'errors':[{'row':0,'cause':'id'},{'row':1,'cause':'amount'},{'row':2,'cause':'amount'},{'row':3,'cause':'unit'},{'row':5,'cause':'duplicate'}]})]; [(lambda before,r,expected: (assert_equal(r,expected),assert_equal(req,before)))(copy.deepcopy(req),evaluate(req,p),expected) for req,expected in cases]; print('edge and immutability checks passed')\",\"-c\"]}},{\"action\":\"run\",\"arguments\":{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import json; from work import evaluate; requests=json.load(open('requests.json')); policy=json.load(open('policy.json')); expected=[evaluate(r,policy) for r in requests]; actual=json.load(open('report.json')); assert actual==expected,(actual,expected); print('report consistency passed')\"]}},{\"action\":\"run\",\"arguments\":{\"command\":[\"git\",\"diff\",\"--\",\"work.py\",\"report.json\"]}},{\"action\":\"run\",\"arguments\":{\"command\":[\"git\",\"status\",\"--short\"]}}]}"}
